alternativeExplanations.title: Reasonableness check
steps: On $[1, 4]$ the function $3\sqrt{x}$ runs from $3$ to $6$ over a width of $3$.
A trapezoid estimate: $\frac{3 + 6}{2} \cdot 3 = 13.5$. Since $\sqrt{x}$ is concave down, the true area is a bit more.
$14$ is just above $13.5$ — exactly what we expect.
